summary: Backend-only regression for the Pros & Cons PDF report collection-name bug fix in routes/decision_reports.py (db.pros_cons_analyses → db.pros_cons). All 5 tests passed against the public preview URL. Owner now gets 200 on /api/reports/pros_cons/{id}/info and 402 (entitlement gating, NOT 404) on /api/reports/pros_cons/{id}.pdf. dezider + swot regression paths still work; nonexistent id correctly returns 404.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/decision_reports.py _load_decision('pros_cons') correctly reads db.pros_cons (line 56) — matches the storage collection used by routes/pros_cons.py. Confirmed by 200 on /info and 402 (not 404) on /.pdf for the owner.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates one TEST_PnC_ReportFix_* analysis via POST /api/pros-cons and deletes it via DELETE /api/pros-cons/{id} on teardown. If a decision/swot did not exist for the regression user, the test conditionally creates one via POST /api/decisions or POST /api/swot.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (the existing test file already falls back to localhost:8001 if unset). Auth token field returned by /api/auth/login is `session_token`. The PDF endpoint returning 402 for an entitlement-less owner is the EXPECTED PASS state for this bug; 404 would be a regression.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: routes/decision_reports.py used db.pros_cons_analyses (which is empty) instead of db.pros_cons (where routes/pros_cons.py actually persists). Fix (single-line, line 56): `await db.pros_cons.find_one({"id": decision_id, "user_id": user_id}, {"_id": 0})`. Repro before fix: create PnC analysis → call /api/reports/pros_cons/{id}/info → 404 'Pros & Cons analysis not found'. After fix: 200 on /info, 402 on /.pdf (entitlement gate, as designed).
